title: Grzegorz K NDE 1089
content: I can't remember the accident itself. I regained my consciousness when I was back in my apartment (that's what I thought). The only difference was that there were cases and cupboards with drugs and medicines everywhere. After some time, a woman appeared. I can't remember if we talked. At one point, a light door appeared in the wall and the woman asked me to come with her through it. We were to be back soon. I agreed because I trusted her. We went through the door. On the other side, she was no longer there. Everything looked like an underground factory (I cannot describe that place, but I guess a factory is what it felt like). There were many people there. They were running naked in all directions. I just sat and observed them. The couldn't see me or they just didn't pay attention to my presence. Some time passed and I wanted to find the exit. I wasted a lot of time and didn't find anything. I was getting upset, angry, and lost consciousness. When I regained it, I was still In that factory, but there were no people this time, just the women that took me there. She said I would stay there (I think the communication was telepathic, we didn't talk in the usual way). I felt deceived. She had said we were going to come back. She asked me what I didn't like about the place. I didn't answer, but I felt she understood my situation. All the people that I would leave on earth came to my mind instantly. I was very sad, for the first time in my life, the feeling of sadness was so strong. I then felt sucked into this world and started to regain consciousness.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A 'light door' appeared in the wall and he went through it.

arrival.other_being_detail: A woman appeared and invited him through a light door; later she said he would stay there.

environment.environment_other_detail: Looked like an 'underground factory'; earlier scene resembled his apartment but filled with cases/cupboards of drugs and medicines.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He 'felt sucked into this world and started to regain consciousness.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Loss of consciousness within the experience and regaining it again while still in the 'factory'.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Regained consciousness in an apartment-like setting, then went through a light door into an underground factory with many people; later lost consciousness, then reawakened in the factory with only the woman present; then returned by being 'sucked into this world.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Initial setting resembled his apartment but filled with cases/cupboards of drugs and medicines; the other realm resembled an 'underground factory' with many naked people running in all directions; people seemed unable/unwilling to notice him; he lost consciousness within the experience and later regained it again in the same place.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “At one point, a light door appeared in the wall and the woman asked me to come with her through it.”; “Everything looked like an underground factory (I cannot describe that place, but I guess a factory is what it felt like).”; “They were running naked in all directions.”; “I think the communication was telepathic, we didn't talk in the usual way.”; “I then felt sucked into this world and started to regain consciousness.”
